name: Taco Salad
description: A hearty taco salad with seasoned ground beef, mixed greens, and crunchy corn chips.
recipeIngredient: ½ to ¾ small bottle Catalina dressing

recipeInstructions.text: Brown the ground hamburger in a frying pan with chopped mushrooms.
Add taco seasoning mix and a little water. Continue cooking until the mixture thickens.
In a large bowl, combine the premixed salad, sliced green pepper, and red onion.
When ready to serve, add the hamburger mixture, crushed corn chips, and Catalina dressing to the salad.
Toss everything together and serve immediately.

keywords: taco salad, Mexican salad, ground beef salad

_similar.name: Taco Ring
_similar.description: A savory taco-flavored ring made with crescent rolls, ground beef, and cheese, served with salsa and fresh toppings.

recipeInstructions.text: Fry the hamburger and let it cool.
Add ¼ cup water and taco seasoning mix to the fried hamburger.
Lay the crescent roll dough on the outside edge of a 15-inch pizza-style pan, forming a circle with the pointed edge out.
Scoop the hamburger mixture onto the dough, leaving a 5-inch wide circle in the center.
Add shredded cheese on top of the hamburger mixture.
Bring the pointed edge of the pastry over the beef mixture and press to seal.
Bake for approximately 16 minutes or as per the directions on the pastry package until golden brown.
Let cool slightly before serving.
To serve, remove the top from the green pepper and scoop out the insides. Place salsa inside the green pepper.
Place the green pepper in the middle of the ring along with shredded lettuce and tomato. Serve with sour cream.

_similar.keywords: taco ring, crescent roll recipe, taco bake, Mexican-inspired

_similar.name: Mexican Salad
_similar.description: A hearty and flavorful salad with kidney beans, lentils, and low-fat cheese, topped with salsa and served with taco chips.
recipeIngredient: ½ cup low-fat cheese (mozzarella or cheddar or combination)

recipeInstructions.text: Combine kidney beans, lentils, diced tomato, shredded lettuce, chopped green pepper, low-fat cheese, and green onions in a large bowl.
Toss the salad with Catalina dressing until well coated.
Top the salad with salsa.
Serve immediately with taco chips on the side.

_similar.keywords: Mexican salad, bean salad, taco chips

_similar.name: Onion Salad
_similar.description: A simple onion salad marinated in a sweet and tangy dressing.

recipeInstructions.text: Marinate the thinly sliced onions with salt, sugar, water, and vinegar overnight.
Drain the marinade well in the morning.
Add mayonnaise (or salad dressing) and celery seed to the drained onions.
Chill until ready to serve.

_similar.keywords: onion salad, marinated onions, sweet and tangy salad

_similar.name: Caribbean Chicken Salad
_similar.description: A refreshing salad featuring chicken, mango, pineapple, and Minute Rice, all tossed in Italian dressing.
recipeIngredient: 1 small can pineapple, diced and drained

recipeInstructions.text: Cook the Minute Rice in chicken broth according to package instructions.
Cook the chicken breast meat in a little oil until fully cooked.
Combine the cooked rice, chicken, and remaining ingredients in a large bowl.
Chill until served. Optional: add other fruits like grapes, mandarins, or plums for variation.

_similar.keywords: Caribbean chicken salad, fruit and rice salad, Italian dressing

_similar.name: Nacho Salad
_similar.description: A spicy nacho salad with ground beef, lettuce, tomatoes, and nacho chips, topped with a creamy dressing.
recipeIngredient: 1/2 cup Monterey Jack cheese (or mozzarella), shredded

recipeInstructions.text: Brown the ground beef with onion and garlic. Drain excess fat.
Add spices and water to the beef mixture. Bring to a boil, then simmer for 15 minutes. Let cool for 10 minutes.
In a large salad bowl, mix together the shredded lettuce, diced tomatoes, shredded cheese, and crushed nacho chips.
In a separate bowl, mix the mayonnaise, relish, ketchup, and hot pepper sauce.
Pour the dressing over the salad and add the cooled meat mixture.
Toss the salad to combine all ingredients and serve.

_similar.keywords: nacho salad, spicy salad, ground beef salad
